sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out the cost background. You asked what volume we can commit: our order volume is fixed and covers our full demand for this part, all placed with you. Our demand forecast is rising, and a long contract term would give you planning security.

We have also considered the movements in the alloy surcharge and producer prices shown below. Your letter of 2026-07-06 says your material is covered at fixed prices, so those recent movements have not yet reached your costs. We recognise that, and your owner’s offer to walk us through the calculation would be helpful. Could you arrange that discussion as part of the review?

In return for the price adjustment we seek, we offer our full demand over a 36-month term. The following proposal gives you a choice: a fixed price, or a price that follows the material index with a deadband, sharing that risk between us. The binding volume statement and supporting data follow.

We confirm a binding volume of 94800 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

The 1.4404 alloy surcharge changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered at fixed prices, so recent index movements do not reach your costs yet.

Our proposal in detail, one of these packages:
- Option A: EUR 4.76 per unit, fixed price, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months
- Option B: EUR 4.71 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving toward us again. We appreciate it. We understand your point that the material was bought at fixed prices through March 2027, so recent alloy surcharge decreases do not yet flow through to your costs. We also note that you checked the index data we cited and took it into account. The cost breakdown you set out is helpful, and we would welcome the calculation walk-through your owner previously offered.

In response to your question on volume, our commitment is for our full demand for this part over the term, all placed with you. Our demand forecast is rising, and the long contract term also gives you planning security. In return for this commitment and 90-day payment terms, we are moving toward you again on price. The order history and the data appended below provide context for our position.

Our proposal and its terms follow, together with the binding volume confirmation.

We confirm a binding volume of 94800 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10, po:4500014305-10).

Our proposal in detail: EUR 5.01 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5.0%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
